title: Mood and energy log
audience: For anyone who wants to see what lifts them and what drains them.
description: An evening mood and energy log. Tell your AI about your day in your own words and it scores and logs it in Pinto Notes.
tagline: A short evening check-in that shows patterns.
seoTitle: Mood and energy log template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Mood and energy log

A short check-in each evening. After a few weeks, the patterns show what lifts you and what drains you.

## Patterns

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Mood and energy log". Each evening I'll tell you about my day in my own words. Read the note with fetch, then add one row to the table with edit: Mood and Energy from 1 (low) to 5 (great), Sleep in hours, Caffeine as one of the options, and one short line in What happened. If you're unsure about a score, ask me instead of guessing. When I ask about patterns, add what you notice under "Patterns". Don't give medical advice.

asks: Today was long but good. Slept 6 hours, two coffees, great lunch with Maja.
What do my best days have in common?
Does caffeine change my energy the next day?

args.old_string: | 2026-09-28 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 2 cups | Long day, great lunch with Maja |
args.new_string:
| 2026-09-28 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 2 cups | Long day, great lunch with Maja |
| 2026-09-29 | 2 | 2 | 5.5 | 3+ cups | Deadline, skipped the walk |

| 2026-09-29 | 2 | 2 | 5.5 | 3+ cups | Deadline, skipped the walk |
| 2026-09-30 | 4 | 4 | 8 | 1 cup | Slept in, finished the report |

## Patterns
- Energy follows sleep: under 6 hours, energy was 2 or lower.
- Three cups of coffee came on the lowest day, not the busiest one.
